key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1AC0
name: compact_duplicate_table_entries
description: Expands a table of 16-bit offsets by adding a base value to each non-zero entry, then scans the 32-bit list of indices and, for every non-negative value, marks later matching entries as removed (all-ones) while decrementing a live count and advancing a running offset by a step value. The final offset and count are written back into the library's state block.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1AE4
name: mark_repeated_table_entries
description: Walks a list of 32-bit indices and, for each non-negative value, marks every later entry equal to it as removed by writing an all-ones value and decrementing the remaining count. It advances a running offset by a step value between groups and stores the final offset and count into the library's state block.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1AF0
name: filter_matching_table_entries
description: Scans a list of 32-bit indices and removes entries equal to a given key with an all-ones value and decrementing the remaining count, storing a fresh value into a parallel output table for each kept group. It advances a running offset and writes the final offset and count into the library's state block.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1B18
name: clip_rectangle_against_bounds
description: Tests a rectangle against a bounds record of four 16-bit limits and returns zero when it lies outside them or would be clipped to nothing. Otherwise it stores the overhang on each side into the state block, reduces the remaining extents by those amounts, and returns one.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1B8A
name: return_zero_without_effect
description: Contains only a return of zero, with no reads, writes or calls, so it is an empty stub in the library.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1B8E
name: compute_scaled_bitmap_row_steps
description: Copies origin and size fields from the source record into the state block, derives fixed-point step values from the width and height ratios, and fills a table of row offsets. It then runs a per-row loop that reads single bits from a bitmap and packs them into 16-bit words, using two helper routines of the library for the row setup.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1BCE
name: derive_second_bitmap_row_offsets
description: Repeats the row step and offset setup for a second state block, negating the step when the flip flags are set. It fills a table of row offsets and packs bits from the bitmap into 16-bit words for each row, reusing the stored remainders.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1BF0
name: return_last_bitmap_row_offset
description: Computes the row step from a divisor passed in a register, builds the row offset table with the same flip handling as its neighbours, and packs bitmap bits into words row by row. It returns the last accumulated offset to the caller.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1C54
name: pack_rows_from_stride_offset
description: Derives a starting offset as the base value plus the row index times the stride stored in the source record, then builds the row offset table and packs bitmap bits into 16-bit words per row. It returns the final offset to the caller.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1C98
name: accumulate_steps_then_pack_rows
description: Adds a step value into an accumulator once per count, then writes the row offsets and packs bitmap bits into 16-bit words row by row. It returns the last computed value to the caller.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1CA6
name: pack_masked_bitmap_rows
description: Writes a row of words with each bit cleared by a mask derived from the shift value, then runs the per-row bit-packing loop over the bitmap. It updates the row count and offset fields in the state block and returns the last accumulated offset.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1CE0
name: pack_bitmap_rows_for_blit
description: Computes the word count and row offsets for a blit from the stored step values, calls the library's blitter wait helper, then packs bitmap bits into 16-bit words row by row. It writes the resulting counts into the state block and returns the last offset.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1D64
name: pack_bitmap_rows_into_words
description: Loops over the rows, reading source bits through an offset table and packing them into 16-bit words, then advances the source pointer by a step held in a register. It repeats for the remaining row count and returns the last computed value.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1DF0
name: advance_and_pack_bitmap_rows
description: Advances the source pointer by a row step and packs bitmap bits into 16-bit words for each row, looping until the remaining row count reaches zero. It shares the same bit-packing core as its neighbours and stores its flag in the state block.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1DF8
name: composite_bitplane_rows_with_masks
description: Walks a row index table and either copies source rows directly, zero-fills rows marked empty, ORs overlapping rows, or applies AND-NOT masks, depending on the mode flags stored in the state block. Each destination row is written from the source bitplane rows selected by the table.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1E34
name: merge_bitplane_rows_by_table
description: ORs a list of source rows into a buffer, then composites destination rows from a row index table: rows marked zero are cleared, rows matching the current index are OR-ed in, and other rows get a masked merge. It writes the result into the destination bitplane rows, using 32-bit operations when the wide flag is set.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1E88
name: overlay_bitplane_rows_by_table
description: Walks the row index table and writes each destination row from source rows, clearing rows marked zero, OR-ing rows that match the current index, and applying a masked merge for the rest. Its row count and width come from the state block.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1E96
name: clear_and_merge_bitplane_rows
description: Clears destination rows with an AND-NOT of the source, then walks the row index table: zero entries clear the row, matching entries OR the source row in, and other entries apply a masked merge. The row count is decremented until the table is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1EA6
name: merge_long_bitplane_rows_table
description: Applies the row index table to a set of destination rows using 32-bit words: zero entries clear the row with an AND-NOT, matching entries OR the source row in, and other entries apply a masked merge. It stops when the row count reaches zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1ED2
name: overlay_long_bitplane_rows
description: OR-es a list of source rows into a buffer in 32-bit words, then writes destination rows from the row index table: zero entries clear the row, matching entries OR the source in, and other entries apply a masked merge. Row count and width come from the state block.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1EE0
name: clear_and_merge_long_rows
description: Clears destination rows in 32-bit words with an AND-NOT of the source, then walks the row index table: zero entries clear the row, matching entries OR the source row in, and other entries apply a masked merge. It stops when the row count is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1EF0
name: copy_or_zero_bitplane_rows
description: Copies each source row into the destination according to an index table and zero-fills rows whose index is zero. A wide flag in the state block selects 32-bit copies, otherwise 16-bit word copies are used.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F18
name: clear_and_copy_word_rows
description: Clears a run of destination rows, then for each table entry with a non-zero index copies a row of 16-bit words from the source bitplane. It returns when the row count is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F24
name: clear_and_copy_long_rows
description: Writes 32-bit rows from the source bitplane for each non-zero table entry and zero-fills the row for entries that are zero. When the table is exhausted it finishes the remaining rows with 16-bit word copies from the same tables.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F40
name: copy_or_clear_word_rows
description: Walks the row index table and either zero-fills the destination row when the index is zero or copies a row of 16-bit words from the source bitplane. The row count comes from the state block and the routine returns once every entry is handled.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F4C
name: setup_blit_edge_masks
description: Derives the row and column offsets from the source record and the state block, builds a per-row address table, and computes the first and last word masks for a clipped rectangle. It then either runs one per-row fill path or the alternative path, depending on the clip flag.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1F90
name: setup_blit_offsets_from_registers
description: Performs the same offset and edge-mask setup as its neighbour, but takes the origin and width from register inputs rather than the source record. It builds the per-row address table and then runs the per-row word fill loop, choosing its path from the clip flag.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:1FEE
name: program_blitter_rows_after_wait
description: Builds the per-row address table and the edge masks from register inputs, then either writes blitter control words, waiting for the blitter to finish between operations through the library's wait helper, or runs the per-row masked word loop. The masks are combined with clear, set or merge operations on each row.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:20D0
name: blit_shifted_masked_bitmap
description: Blits a bitmap into destination rows at a bit shift: for each row it clears the destination bits covered by a shifted mask word, then ORs in the shifted data word. Partial edge words at each end of the row are handled separately, and the row pointers advance by the stride values.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2114
name: blit_shifted_rows_with_merge
description: Repeats the shifted masked blit over a rectangle, choosing per row between clearing destination bits with a mask and OR-ing in a shifted data word. The choice depends on whether the source row pointer matches a marker value, and edge words are handled per row.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:212A
name: blit_shifted_rows_with_clip
description: Performs the shifted masked blit row by row with row and column counters that stop the loop when either runs out. Each row clears or ORs destination words depending on whether the source row pointer matches a marker, with partial edge words handled at each end.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2158
name: blit_shifted_rows_by_or
description: Blits shifted source words into destination rows over a rectangle by OR-ing them in, clearing destination bits first only on rows whose source pointer differs from the marker. Row pointers advance by the stored stride values until the row count is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:216C
name: blit_shifted_or_with_clip
description: Performs a row-by-row shifted OR blit bounded by row and column counters. Each row ORs shifted words into the destination, clearing the covered bits first for rows whose pointer differs from the marker, and stops when either counter runs out.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:219E
name: blit_right_shifted_rows_merge
description: Blits source words shifted right by a count derived from the negated shift value, clearing destination bits with an AND-NOT mask and then OR-ing the shifted words in on each row. Row pointers advance by the stored stride, and the loop stops when the row count is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:21E8
name: blit_right_shifted_masked_bitmap
description: Blits a bitmap into destination rows at a right bit shift: for each row it clears the covered destination bits with a shifted mask word, then ORs in the shifted data word. Partial edge words are handled at each end, and row pointers advance by the stored stride values.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2228
name: merge_right_shifted_rows
description: Walks a rectangle of rows applying a right-shifted mask and data word to each destination row: it clears the covered bits with AND-NOT and ORs in the shifted source words. The pointer comparison against the marker chooses between the clear-and-merge path and the plain path for each row.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2242
name: blit_right_shifted_or_clip
description: Performs a right-shifted row blit bounded by row and column counters, ORing shifted source words into the destination. Rows whose pointer differs from the marker are cleared first with an AND-NOT mask, and the loop ends when either counter runs out.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:226E
name: blit_right_shifted_by_or
description: Blits right-shifted source words into destination rows by OR-ing them in over the rectangle, clearing bits first only on rows whose source pointer differs from the marker. Row pointers advance by the stored strides until the row count is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2286
name: blit_right_shifted_rows_clipped
description: Performs a right-shifted row blit bounded by row and column counters, ORing shifted words into the destination. Rows whose pointer differs from the marker are cleared first with an AND-NOT mask, and the routine returns when either counter is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:22B6
name: copy_table_rows_with_masks
description: Copies or merges source rows into destination rows according to an index table: when the mode flag is set, rows are written directly and zero-filled for empty entries; otherwise destination words are cleared with an AND-NOT mask and the source words are ORed in, with a masked merge for other indices.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:22E8
name: blit_masked_rows_with_clip
description: Blits rows into the destination with a mask: for each word it clears the covered bits with an AND-NOT and ORs in the source word. Row and column counters bound the loop, and a marker check on the source pointer selects the path for each row.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2306
name: blit_unshifted_rows_by_or
description: Blits unshifted source words into destination rows by OR-ing them over the rectangle, clearing destination bits first on rows whose source pointer differs from the marker. Row pointers advance by the stored strides until the row count is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:230E
name: blit_unshifted_rows_or_clip
description: Performs an unshifted row blit bounded by row and column counters, clearing the covered bits and ORing source words in on rows whose pointer differs from the marker. Rows matching the marker are OR-ed only, and the routine returns when either counter runs out.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2326
name: overlay_unshifted_rows_by_table
description: ORs source rows into the destination first, then walks the row index table: empty entries clear the row with an AND-NOT, matching entries OR the source in, and other entries apply a masked merge. Row pointers advance until the row count is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:232E
name: overlay_unshifted_rows_with_clip
description: Performs the table-driven row merge bounded by row and column counters: empty entries clear the destination row, matching entries OR the source words in, and others apply a masked merge. The loop returns when either counter runs out.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:234C
name: copy_rows_zero_empty_entries
description: Copies rows of 16-bit words from the source pointers into the destination, zero-filling rows whose table entry is empty or out of range. It advances to the next table entry until the row count reaches zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2362
name: zero_or_copy_rows_clip
description: Writes zero words for rows that fall outside the clip bounds and copies source words for the rest, looping over the row table. It returns once the row counter reaches zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2378
name: fill_zero_rows_then_copy
description: Zero-fills a block of destination rows, then for each table entry copies a row of 16-bit words from the source pointer. The copy is skipped when the entry is empty or outside the clip limit.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2380
name: copy_rows_or_zero_clip
description: Copies source rows of 16-bit words into the destination for each table entry, writing a zero word for entries that are empty or outside the clip bounds. It stops when the row and column counters are exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:239C
name: merge_byte_offset_bitplane_rows
description: Merges byte-addressed bitplane rows using the row index table, with the starting byte offset adjusted when the doubled shift value carries or is negative. Empty entries clear the row, matching entries OR the source in, and other entries apply a masked merge.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:23E8
name: overlay_byte_rows_with_clip
description: Performs a byte-wise table merge bounded by row and column counters: source byte rows are OR-ed into the destination, empty entries clear the row, and matching or other entries apply the merge rules. The loop returns when either counter is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2406
name: clear_then_merge_byte_rows
description: Clears a block of byte-wide destination rows with an AND-NOT of the mask, then walks the row index table: matching entries OR the source row in, and other entries apply a masked merge. Row pointers advance by the stored strides.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:240E
name: merge_byte_rows_with_clip
description: Merges byte-wide rows bounded by row and column counters: source bytes are OR-ed into destination rows for matching entries, and masked merges are applied when the source pointer differs from the marker. The loop ends when either counter runs out.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2426
name: overlay_byte_rows_by_table
description: ORs source byte rows into the destination first, then walks the row index table: empty entries clear the row with an AND-NOT, matching entries OR the source in, and other entries apply a masked merge. Row pointers advance until the row count is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:242E
name: overlay_byte_rows_clip_merge
description: Performs the table-driven byte-row overlay after an OR pass, bounded by row and column counters: empty entries clear the row, and other entries merge source bytes under a mask. The routine returns when either counter is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:244C
name: program_blitter_masks_and_modulos
description: Sets the blitter's first and last word masks, the source and destination modulos and the shift control register for a clipped rectangle, adjusting pointers and row counts to match. It then writes each row's addresses into the blitter and waits for the blitter between operations.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:250C
name: start_blitter_row_pointers
description: For each row, writes the source A, B, C and D pointer registers of the blitter with the row addresses and selects the mask combination for the row. It waits for the blitter to finish and loops until the row count is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2542
name: feed_blitter_source_words
description: Writes source words into the blitter's A-data register for each row, taking the row pointer from the table and selecting the mask word for the row. The row count is decremented until it reaches zero.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2552
name: start_blitter_rows_with_size
description: Writes the A-data word, the control register and the blit size register for each row, starting one blitter operation per row. It waits for the blitter between rows and returns when the row count is exhausted.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2576
name: copy_request_rows_via_blitter
description: Reads a request record from the state block, clears its flag bytes, and copies the rows it describes. When the blit flag is set it programs the blitter with a copy control word and per-row addresses, waiting for the blitter between rows; otherwise it copies the words of each row directly with the row stride.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:25D0
name: start_blitter_copy_rows
description: Programs the blitter's B and D modulo registers, pointers and size for a set of rows with a fixed copy control word. It starts one copy per row and waits for the blitter to finish between rows.

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:27E0
name: call_helpers_if_count_positive

name: call_helpers_when_count_nonnegative

name: copy_counted_long_table

key: captive ii - liberation (1992)(mindscape)[cr dlm](disk 1 of 5)[a3]/Captive II - Liberation (1992)(Mindscape)[cr DLM](Disk 1 of 5)[a3].adf:libs/vector.library:0:2914
name: copy_counted_long_pairs
description: Reads a count word from the source record and stores it in the state block, then copies 32-bit entries into the state table two at a time until the count runs out.

name: compute_table_min_max_bounds
description: Scans the count-prefixed table of 16-bit pairs in the state block, tracking the lowest and highest value in each of the two columns. It stores the four resulting bounds into the state block.

name: scan_table_min_max_bounds
description: Scans a table of 16-bit pairs for as many entries as a register count gives, tracking the minimum and maximum of each column. It stores the four bounds into the state block.

description: Forbids multitasking, opens the graphics library through the system library, makes a series of library calls on the returned base, and stores the results with the interrupt and DMA register readings in the state block. It returns minus one when the open fails and zero otherwise.

name: setup_copper_list_and_interrupts

key: runtime segment $004400-$005380:0:0B0C
